edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence point in more than one direction, so no single pooled effect estimate is reliable enough to summarize cleanly.
edges.mechanism: This exposure is studied mainly through oxidative stress, endocrine disruption, inflammatory signaling, or direct tissue toxicity, with the dominant pathway varying by pollutant. For Non-Hodgkin lymphoma, the main uncertainty is usually exposure measurement rather than complete biologic implausibility.
edges.summary: Glyphosate exposure appears tied to mixed effects on non-hodgkin lymphoma in occupationally exposed adults mainly through pooled meta-analytic evidence. The likely magnitude is modest, which is why the edge is framed conservatively rather than as a headline-level breakthrough.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.

evidence.notes: Exposure to glyphosate and risk of non-Hodgkin lymphoma: an updated meta-analysis.
